page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a-nps1.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance based on the x86_64 architecture. It is driven by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz. The platform delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores using simultaneous multithreading with two threads per core. System memory totals 64.0 GB, establishing a strict 1:2 compute-to-memory profile with 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware features include 32 MB of L3 cache alongside support for AES, VAES, and standard AVX vector extensions, though advanced AVX-512 and AMX extensions are absent.

Network baseline performance is provisioned at 8 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor. The configuration does not include local storage disks or integrated graphics processing units, meaning all operating system and persistent data requirements rely exclusively on external network-attached block storage. This storage design requires architectural consideration for I/O-intensive workloads, as disk throughput is constrained by network storage limits rather than local NVMe bus speeds.

Benchmark measurements indicate strong single-core CPU throughput, with stress-ng single-core performance placing in the top quartile of tested instances. PassMark memory testing also registers in the upper 25% bracket. Multi-threaded performance falls into the median range across wider server evaluations, posting a multi-core Geekbench score of 13194.0 and achieving 144.85 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Static web serving throughput reaches 23.65 GB/sec, while in-memory operations achieve 30.6 million Redis SET operations per second.

Given its dedicated core allocation and balanced compute density, the ecs.c7a-nps1.8xlarge provides dependable multi-threaded processing efficiency. The instance profile is suited for continuous integration build agents, software compilation tasks, batch data processing, and scalable web application backends that do not require local disk caching.
